webview2.ask:
Comfy Launcher couldn't find Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime on this computer. The launcher needs it to show the ComfyUI interface.

Download and install it now? Windows may ask for permission.
webview2.installing:
Installing WebView2 Runtime...
Please don't close this window.
webview2.done: Done. Comfy Launcher will now start.
webview2.found.title: WebView2 Runtime installed
webview2.found.text: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is now installed. Continue launching Comfy Launcher?
webview2.failed:
Installation failed: {reason}

You can install it manually: {url}
webview2.reason.offline: couldn't download the installer. Check your internet connection.
webview2.reason.timeout: the installer didn't finish in {minutes} minutes.
webview2.reason.http: the download server returned an error (HTTP {status}).
webview2.reason.still_missing: the installer finished (code {code}), but WebView2 Runtime still wasn't found.

main.stop.text: Completely stop ComfyUI and terminate the process?
main.exit.title: Exit
slow_start.title: ComfyUI is taking longer than usual
slow_start.text: It is still loading - this is normal with many custom nodes or a slow disk. You can keep waiting or stop the start.
console.title: ComfyUI Console
console.hint: View-only. To type into the console, enable “{setting}” in Settings.
placeholder.title: No embedded engine on this platform
placeholder.text: ComfyUI is running and reachable, but no web engine is wired up for this platform yet. Open the interface in your browser.
error.comfy_path_invalid.title: Incorrect path to ComfyUI
error.comfy_path_invalid.message: The specified folder does not contain ComfyUI or is corrupted.
error.comfy_path_invalid.hint: Open {builds}, choose the correct ComfyUI folder and try again.
error.process_start_failed.title: Failed to start ComfyUI
error.process_start_failed.message: The ComfyUI process did not start.
error.process_start_failed.hint: Check {logs} for errors and make sure ComfyUI is installed correctly.
error.comfy_start_timeout.title: ComfyUI is not responding
error.comfy_start_timeout.message: ComfyUI stopped showing any activity before its server came up.
error.comfy_start_timeout.hint: Check that the ComfyUI folder is correct. Try restarting the launcher or look in {logs}.
error.comfy_process_exited.title: ComfyUI stopped during startup
error.comfy_process_exited.message: The ComfyUI process exited before its server came up.
error.comfy_process_exited.hint: The reason is usually in the ComfyUI console output: check the console window or {logs}.
error.comfy_start_stopped.title: Startup stopped
error.comfy_start_stopped.message: You stopped ComfyUI while it was still loading.
error.comfy_start_stopped.hint: Press Restart in the header to start it again. If it is always slow to start, raise the limit in {startup}.
error.port_already_in_use.title: The port is occupied
error.port_already_in_use.message: The ComfyUI port ({port}) is already in use by another process.
error.port_already_in_use.hint: Close the program that is using this port - often another ComfyUI.
